primary_source.reading_scope: Boundary inverse source route and quotient identities only; full book reading and unproved complex-sector results are not claimed.

source_correspondence: B0 checks the exact affine operator and intrinsic normal derivative sign, with an arbitrary finite complex matrix multiplier of ordinary order zero.
B1 constructs an actual outgoing solution by a uniformly convergent Volterra series, differentiates its integrable kernel and proves its first asymptotics.
B2 proves the exact recurrence, weighted contraction and all differentiated remainders by comparing deeper finite expansions.
B3 extends the solution by the earlier ordered ODE proof, computes the constant signed flux, excludes real zeros of both value and derivative, and identifies the real Airy basis with exact constants.

B4 derives the positive Gaussian expansion, reduction-of-order growing solution and full Laplace remainder estimates. Together with the oscillatory ray and compact nonvanishing these prove every global quotient and reciprocal bound.
B5 proves every frequency derivative bound at the transition and keeps n_minus equal to minus the conjugate of n_plus for D=-i partial.
B6 proves the ordered finite-matrix inverse without a symmetry assumption, exact reflection law and all-real two-thirds boundary-source Sobolev gain.
B7 proves polynomial bounds for the normalized modes and every derivative, actual tempered-distribution solutions and traces, and uniqueness in the prescribed two-mode class.
Three complete solutions prove the nilpotent nonnormal formula, optimal transition gain and infinitely many poles of the real derivative quotient.
Seven finite groups contain 39 exact checks and 90 separately labelled numerical samples. One original three-panel illustration distinguishes numerical samples from the exact transition power.
The full variable-base boundary phase, amplitude transport, operator inverse and weak energy transfer remain to be proved; model closure does not certify general strict propagation.
